notes: TBox delete of a stored rule. Members stay in the class in every world; a world with the member's value stored by name keeps it, a world that reached it only through the rule loses it (stores). The core-fusion processes are individuals; 'What does it fuse?' presupposes one process per star (firm rule). q1 reads 'Is helium the fuel?' as fusing hydrogen into helium, and q3 'does the fusion produce helium?' as fusing hydrogen into helium (the two processes in play).
